name: performline-insights
description: PerformLine acquisition, behavior, AI visibility and blog reporting on top of GA4 + Google Search Console

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.refresh: node -e "import('./server/src/report.js').then(async m => console.log(JSON.stringify(await m.warmReports({ store: (await import('./server/src/store.js')).createStore() }), null, 2)))"
